Speaker notes
Early-warning research links longitudinal indicators with opportunities for timely support. EduGuard implements that idea as a complete workflow in which teachers interpret signals, act, and review subsequent progress.

Visual / diagram suggestion
Five connected stages with a follow-up return path beneath them.

Speaker notes
Longitudinal monitoring and intervention are established ideas in early-warning research. EduGuard’s contribution is their integration with tenant-safe storage and a deliberately restricted student view, rather than a claim that all existing systems lack these capabilities.

Speaker notes
The implementation uses an eight-week observation window and preserves missing values for the fitted imputer. The risk bands are configured decision rules, and the measured explanation signals do not establish causation or calibrated predictive accuracy.

text:
Speaker notes
Students see measured progress, streaks and supportive actions, while authorized teachers see advisory risk signals and private intervention details. This design reduces exposure and labeling risks, but fairness requires empirical checks and cannot be guaranteed by hiding scores.

Visual / diagram suggestion
A role-partition matrix paired with a clearly marked remaining fairness-validation requirement.
